launch.title: Launch validation (fake MO2 only)
launch.invalidBeforeStart: invalid wait timeout fails before any native launch
launch.dangerBeforeStart: missing acknowledgement cannot start a process
launch.expectedBeforeStart: expected profile mismatch cannot start a process
launch.dequeueBusy: launch rechecks busy at native execution
launch.waitSemantics: configured defaults and finite wait values retain their behavior
launch.noWaitIgnored: nonwaiting launches ignore unused timeout input
launch.retrySingleStart: retry retains the original outcome without another launch
launch.argvPreserved: argv and native argument fragments remain available
launch.handleOwned: the launcher releases its owned handle
